    let n : K.ConnectedComponent → {c : K.ConnectedComponent // c ≠ cb} :=

    have hn (c : K.ConnectedComponent) (hc : c ≠ cb) : (n c).val = c := by
      simp [n, hc]

      apply Subtype.ext
      simp [n, hne]
    let M : K.ConnectedComponent → G.ConnectedComponent :=
      SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.map (SimpleGraph.Hom.ofLE hle)
